verdict.rationale: Jira exposes a REST API that community members confirm using for real queries (jira-comm-20), and Atlassian markets 'Rich APIs' (jira-docs-1), but probes found no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at standard developer.atlassian.com paths, suggesting the API isn't packaged for AI-native/agentic discovery. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, an llms.txt or AI-oriented API index, and richer first-party API documentation beyond a single marketing bullet.
